failure_mode: Shared or duplicate account
potential_effect: Actions cannot be attributed to one person
existing_control: Unique user record; local/LDAP identity; audit actor snapshot
additional_control: Approve account SOP; test duplicates and offboarding

failure_mode: Conflicting roles or self approval
existing_control: Role conflict matrix; record-level independence checks
additional_control: Approve actual role matrix; periodic access review

failure_mode: User accesses unauthorized warehouse
existing_control: UserWarehouse mapping and current warehouse checks
additional_control: Test list/detail/action/export and session after revoke

failure_mode: Brute force or disabled account remains usable
existing_control: Persistent login failure throttle; active flag
additional_control: Monitor authentication failures and emergency access

failure_mode: Wrong expired replayed or altered signature accepted
existing_control: Reauthentication; five minute single-use challenge; payload digest
additional_control: Full negative and concurrency matrix

failure_mode: REJECTION meaning not accepted
existing_control: Schema/model/database allowed meanings; migration 27
additional_control: Test all three rejection routes end to end

failure_mode: Audit event altered deleted or chain broken
existing_control: Append-only API; before/after; SHA-256 chain and lock
additional_control: Restrict database role; scheduled verification; restore check

failure_mode: System clock drift or timezone ambiguity
existing_control: UTC application time; NTP deployment control
additional_control: Monitor offset; define approved timezone

failure_mode: Expired or incomplete supplier used
existing_control: Partner documents and independent approval with validity
additional_control: Migrate approved evidence and periodic review

failure_mode: Supplier provides unauthorized drug
existing_control: Supplier-product authorization checked at four process points
additional_control: Approve catalogue and expiry alerts

failure_mode: Incomplete or unapproved drug profile
potential_effect: Wrong storage traceability or regulatory decision
existing_control: Quality profile approval and required evidence
additional_control: Independent migration verification

failure_mode: Receipt without approved purchase order
existing_control: Receipt tied to approved PO and cumulative quantity
additional_control: Test supplier/product/quantity mismatch

failure_mode: Receiver inspects own receipt or releases without sampling
existing_control: Separate roles; mandatory sampling record
additional_control: Test same user and missing/duplicate sampling

failure_mode: Expired or insufficient shelf-life batch accepted or shipped
existing_control: Expiry checks at receipt acceptance allocation review and dispatch
additional_control: Boundary tests using approved timezone and threshold

failure_mode: Legacy route changes GSP drug stock
existing_control: Legacy mutations blocked for GSP-managed products
additional_control: Verify every legacy mutation endpoint

failure_mode: Concurrent allocation creates oversell or partial reservation
existing_control: Row locks; atomic transaction; reserved quantity
additional_control: Concurrent two-session test and failure injection

failure_mode: Held batch allocated picked or shipped
existing_control: Repeated hold and qualification checks across outbound steps
additional_control: Test hold introduced between steps

failure_mode: Unqualified customer or conflicting staff ships goods
existing_control: Customer evidence; approval; role separation
additional_control: Test expiry/suspension after approval and each actor conflict

failure_mode: Return exceeds original shipment or enters available stock before inspection
existing_control: Original shipment link; cumulative limit; quarantine
additional_control: Partial return and concurrent cumulative test

failure_mode: Registrant approves rejects or destroys own record
existing_control: Independent approval execution and witness
additional_control: Use separate accounts and signature evidence

failure_mode: Cancellation deletes details or blocks legitimate recreation
potential_effect: Loss of history or inability to process
existing_control: Cancelled/rejected status retains rows; active-state uniqueness
additional_control: PR32 cancel/reject/recreate and persistence test

failure_mode: Same NC used by concurrent active returns
potential_effect: Duplicate supplier return and stock deduction
existing_control: NC row lock; check active statuses; non-unique history index
additional_control: Concurrent creation and no-partial-state test

failure_mode: Targets or recovered quantities incomplete
existing_control: Trace from shipped batches; target and progress tracking
additional_control: Reconcile trace query and recall targets

failure_mode: Recall closed before notification or releases hold
existing_control: Independent close; notification checks; hold retained
additional_control: Negative close and post-close hold check

failure_mode: Duplicate altered or missing readings go undetected
existing_control: Source idempotency; raw digest; hash chain; offline alarm
additional_control: Real gateway remains deferred; validate internal logic and label limitation

failure_mode: Counter approves adjustment or inventory changes after baseline
existing_control: Blind count; separated approval/execution; baseline version check
additional_control: Concurrent inventory change test

failure_mode: Records lost mistransformed truncated or inaccessible
existing_control: Frozen source hash; mapping; counts; samples; read-only archive
additional_control: Independent data owner reconciliation and rollback drill

failure_mode: Backup corrupt or shares production failure domain
existing_control: Custom-format dump; SHA; list check; evidence record
additional_control: Approved offsite/offline copy and independent review

failure_mode: No proven restore or RTO/RPO failure
existing_control: Controlled recovery drill state machine
additional_control: Restore full representative database and verify audit chain

failure_mode: Duplicate lost or unapproved external messages
existing_control: Transactional outbox; idempotency; retry; dead letter
additional_control: Keep deferred adapters disabled; validate mapping and reconciliation before enablement

failure_mode: Credentials committed logged or exposed in evidence
existing_control: External injection; version references; strict schemas
additional_control: Repository/log/evidence scan and rotation drill

failure_mode: Executed migration or approved file silently modified
existing_control: Git history; forward-only revisions; document status
additional_control: Baseline hash and change impact review
